description_en: The five-bayed Calakhu Bhairava Phalcā issituated at the crossroad of Calakhu Square to the south-east of Piṃbahāl pond. It is named after the open shrine of Ākāśa Bhairava that is located just in front of it. The carving style of its columns suggesst that it was built in the 1870s. On its northern side, thephalcāadjoins the compound wall of a private building. In 2000, thephalcāwas partly dismantled and restored. Seven columns and capitals were preserved and are in good condition, even though two were placed in the wrong position. The brickwork is partly preserved and the roof was renewed. It is said that originally there were twophalcās, one with two bays and one with three, which were joined to become one.
description_ne: चलखु भैरव फल्चा चलखु चौबाटो छेउमा पिंबाहाल पोखरीको दक्षिणपट्टि रहेको छ । पाँचवटा कवल रहेको यस फल्चामा रहेका काष्ठस्तम्भमा रहेका बुट्टाका आधारमा यी स्तम्भ करिब सन् १८७० तिर बनेको अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ । यस फल्चाको अगाडि आकाश भैरवको मन्दिर रहेको हुनाले उनै देवताको नाममा यो फल्चाको नाम रहेको हो । उत्तरपट्टि यो फल्चा एउटा निजी आवाससँग जोडिएको छ । सन् २००० मा यो फल्चाको केही भाग पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो । पुनर्निर्माणको क्रममा पुराना  स्तम्भ र दलिन प्रयोग गरियो, ईंटाहरू केही मात्र प्रयोग गरियो भने छाना पूरै नयाँ हालियो । स्थानीयको भनाइ अनुसार पहिला यहाँ दुईटा कवल भएको एउटा र तीन वटा कवल भएको एउटा गरी दुईवटा फल्चा थिए, पुनर्निर्माण गर्दा दुईटालाई जोडेर एउटै बनाइयो ।
monument_assessment: Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired), Repaired

historical_events.event_name: Exhibition during the Photo Kathmandu Festival
historical_events.event_description: Calakhu Bhairava Phalcā was part of the first Photo Kathmandu exhibition organised by Photo.Circle. It was part of the exhibition "Patis in Patan", co-curated by Christiane Brosius, Sujan Chitrakar and Rajendra Shakya. Two portrait photographs of people frequently using thephalcāwere exhibited in thephalcāfrom November-December 2015.
